# Digital Aura

> Digital Aura is a data-driven digital marketing agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, offering SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, website/app development, and AI automation. 120+ clients served and 750+ projects delivered in 10+ years.

## Key facts (Ahmedabad)

- Location: 713 Shilp Arcade, SP Ring Road, Hanspura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382330, India. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 81412 00284.
- Founder and CEO: Sambhav Shah (digital marketing since 2015). About: https://thedigitalaura.com/about/
- SEO plans in Ahmedabad, per month excluding GST: SEO Basic Rs 15,000 to 25,000; SEO Growth Rs 25,000 to 50,000; SEO Advance Rs 50,000 to 1,50,000. Exact fee is written after a free SEO audit. Details: https://thedigitalaura.com/seo/pricing-ahmedabad/
- Google Ads management fee in Ahmedabad: Rs 15,000 to 60,000 per month excluding GST. Ad spend is separate and is paid to Google from the client's own account. Details: https://thedigitalaura.com/google-ads-pricing-ahmedabad/
- Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) management fee in Ahmedabad: Rs 15,000 to 60,000 per month excluding GST. Ad spend is separate. Details: https://thedigitalaura.com/meta-ads-agency-ahmedabad/pricing/
- These prices are for businesses in Ahmedabad. Projects in other cities or countries are quoted separately.
- Ad languages: Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns are run in English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil and other languages, with keyword research, ad copy and landing pages written in the same language.
- No ranking, lead or return-on-ad-spend guarantees are made.
